senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn on the ear

ex.en: She wears gold earrings to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴着金耳环去参加聚会。

ex.en: I lost one of my earrings.
ex.zh: 我丢了一只耳环。

tip: earring 复数 earrings；一对耳环说 a pair of earrings。
scene: A pair of gold earrings lying on a jewellery box on a dressing table.

senses.en: To continue having something rather than giving it away.
To stay, or make something stay, in a particular state.
To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.

ex.en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。

ex.en: Governments should keep public transport affordable to encourage residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 政府应使公共交通保持价格实惠，鼓励居民不开私家车出行。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为kept；继续做用keep doing。

senses.en: happening later than planned

ex.en: The train is delayed by twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 火车延误二十分钟。

ex.en: Our flight was delayed because of the weather.
ex.zh: 我们的航班因为天气延误了。

tip: delayed 常用于交通：航班/火车延误。注意：延迟的航班说 delayed flight。
scene: An airport screen showing a delayed flight next to a waiting passenger.

senses.en: On the side opposite the right.
Towards or on the side opposite the right.
Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.

ex.en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
ex.zh: 我用左手提购物袋。

ex.en: Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.
ex.zh: 驾驶员左转前应仔细查看后视镜，尤其是在与骑行者共用道路的地方。

tip: 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词；表剩余时置于名词后。

senses.en: The sport of riding waves while standing on a board.
The activity of browsing websites on the internet.

ex.en: We went surfing at the beach early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早我们去海滩冲浪了。

ex.en: The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.
ex.zh: 冲浪运动日益流行，既能促进沿海经济，也会加大脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。

tip: 运动用go surfing；网上浏览也可说surf the internet。

senses.en: to move something into a particular place or position
to express something in a particular way
to cause someone or something to enter a particular state

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。

ex.en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

col: put something in place｜落实某项安排
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

senses.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期日一起做一顿丰盛的午餐。

ex.en: Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆星期日开放，让工作日忙碌的人也能享用重要的社区服务。

tip: 星期名称首字母大写；on Sunday，但next Sunday不用on。

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
ex.zh: 救生员从深水中救起了一个孩子。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以节省通勤者的时间，并降低家庭出行成本。

tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。

senses.en: used to say something is possible

ex.en: She might come to the party, but she's not sure.
ex.zh: 她可能会来参加聚会，但还不确定。

ex.en: It might snow tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天可能会下雪。

tip: might 表示可能性，比 may 更不确定。
scene: A girl looking at a cloudy sky wondering if it might snow.

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

senses.en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising
Not known or experienced before

ex.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里传出一阵奇怪的声音。

ex.en: Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.
ex.zh: 在游客看来奇怪的习俗，可能体现了当地社区重要的社会价值观。

tip: strange 可指奇怪，也可指陌生；stranger 是陌生人。

senses.en: Most recent or newest.
The most recent news, developments, or products.

ex.en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
ex.zh: 你听说关于我们邻居的最新消息了吗？

ex.en: The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.
ex.zh: 最新研究表明，规律运动可以改善记忆力和心理健康。

tip: latest指最新；last常指上一个或最后一个。

senses.en: a long reptile without legs
to move or extend along a winding path

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
ex.zh: 一条小蛇悄悄滑过干草丛。

ex.en: Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.
ex.zh: 虽然蛇常令人恐惧，但它们通过控制啮齿动物及其他动物的数量，帮助维持生态平衡。

tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

senses.en: a tall cupboard used for storing clothes
all the clothes that a person owns

ex.en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
ex.zh: 她的冬季外套占了衣柜的大部分空间。

ex.en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
ex.zh: 减少衣物数量并选择耐穿的服装，可以降低时尚消费对环境的影响。

tip: 既指衣柜，也可指某人拥有的全部衣物。

senses.en: a document showing that something has been paid for
the act of receiving something
money received by a business or organisation

ex.en: Keep your receipt in case the shoes don't fit.
ex.zh: 留好收据，以防鞋子不合脚。

ex.en: Businesses should issue a receipt for every purchase to protect consumers and maintain accurate financial records.
ex.zh: 商家应为每笔购买开具收据，以保护消费者并保留准确的财务记录。

tip: p不发音；表示收入时通常用复数receipts。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms

ex.en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
ex.zh: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。

ex.en: Building a new hotel near the station could create jobs and attract more visitors to the area.
ex.zh: 在车站附近新建一家酒店可以创造就业机会，并吸引更多游客前来。

tip: 表示住酒店可用stay at或stay in a hotel。

senses.en: to become husband and wife

ex.en: They are going to get married next spring.
ex.zh: 他们明年春天要结婚了。

ex.en: My cousin got married last weekend.
ex.zh: 我表哥上周末结婚了。

tip: get married 表示“结婚”的动作；be married 表示“已婚”状态。
scene: A happy couple in wedding clothes cutting a cake in a garden.

senses.en: Clothing hanging from the waist, without separate sections for legs.
To move around the edge of something.
To avoid dealing directly with a difficult subject.

ex.en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
ex.zh: 她上楼时，蓝色裙子轻轻摆动。

ex.en: Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 公共讨论往往回避谁应承担环保费用这一问题。

col: skirt the edge of｜沿……边缘行进
tip: skirt是裙子；dress通常指连衣裙。

senses.en: to become an adult

ex.en: She grew up in a small town near the sea.
ex.zh: 她在海边的一个小镇长大。

ex.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
ex.zh: 你长大后想做什么？

tip: grow up 表示“长大成人”；grown-up 是名词“成年人”。
scene: A photo album showing a baby growing into a smiling adult.

senses.en: An edge or surface of something, or the space beside it.
One aspect of something or one group in a disagreement.
To support one person or group in a disagreement.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在侧门旁。

ex.en: Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.
ex.zh: 在作出任何重大政策决定之前，公共讨论都应考虑问题的正反两面。

col: the other side of the argument｜争论的另一面
tip: side with表示支持某方；side by side表示并排。

senses.en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.

ex.en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
ex.zh: 一只好奇的山羊把头探出了围栏。

ex.en: Raising goats can provide rural families with a reliable source of milk and additional income.
ex.zh: 饲养山羊可以为农村家庭提供稳定的奶源和额外收入。

col: a herd of goats｜一群山羊
tip: goat是山羊，sheep是绵羊；替罪羊用scapegoat。

senses.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。

ex.en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

col: a pretty dress｜漂亮的连衣裙
tip: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

senses.en: To reach the place you were travelling to.
For an event or a particular time to come.

ex.en: Our guests arrived just as dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我们的客人恰好在晚饭准备好时到了。

ex.en: Reliable public transport helps employees arrive at work on time and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通有助于员工准时上班，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: arrive at the station｜到达车站
arrive in a city｜抵达城市
arrive at a conclusion｜得出结论
tip: 小地点用 at，城市国家用 in；home 前不加介词。

senses.en: more than is wanted, needed, or suitable
in addition; also

ex.en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
ex.zh: 这汤现在太烫，还不能喝。

ex.en: Public transport cannot attract more passengers if fares are too high for regular commuters.
ex.zh: 如果票价对日常通勤者而言过高，公共交通就无法吸引更多乘客。

col: too tired to work｜累得无法工作
tip: too强调超过合适程度；very只强调程度高。

senses.en: Easy to understand, see, or hear
Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light
To remove unwanted things from a place

ex.en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
ex.zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；非常清楚的
tip: make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

senses.en: A website or page with regularly added posts.
To write and publish posts on a blog.

ex.en: She writes a blog about growing vegetables at home.
ex.zh: 她写一个介绍在家种菜的博客。

ex.en: A well-researched blog can make scientific information more accessible to readers without specialist knowledge.
ex.zh: 一个研究充分的博客可以让没有专业知识的读者更容易理解科学信息。

col: blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

senses.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

ex.en: She keeps digital copies of all her family photos.
ex.zh: 她保存着所有家庭照片的电子副本。

ex.en: Improving digital skills can help older adults access public services and maintain contact with distant relatives.
ex.zh: 提高数字技能可以帮助老年人使用公共服务，并与远方亲属保持联系。

tip: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The polite child held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。

ex.en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
ex.zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。

col: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌
tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers.
A drinking container, or the amount it holds.
Lenses held in a frame worn to improve sight.

ex.en: The ball hit the window and shattered the glass.
ex.zh: 球砸中了窗户，把玻璃打碎了。

ex.en: Recycling glass reduces demand for raw materials and can lower energy consumption in the manufacturing sector.
ex.zh: 回收玻璃能减少对原材料的需求，并可降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 玻璃不可数，玻璃杯可数；眼镜用复数glasses。

senses.en: Used to connect alternatives or choices
Used to introduce what happens if something is not done

ex.en: Would you like rice or noodles with your vegetables?
ex.zh: 蔬菜配米饭还是面条，你想选哪一种？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport or face increasing congestion and air pollution in major cities.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则大城市将面临日益严重的拥堵和空气污染。

tip: 否定句中连接并列项常用or，不用and。

senses.en: A very large sea mammal that breathes air.

ex.en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
ex.zh: 一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。

ex.en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
ex.zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

tip: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼；复数通常为whales。

senses.en: eggs beaten and cooked flat in a pan

ex.en: She made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
ex.zh: 她做了奶酪煎蛋卷当早餐。

ex.en: I'd like an omelette with mushrooms, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一份蘑菇煎蛋卷。

tip: omelette 是摊开的煎蛋饼，可加奶酪、蔬菜等。
scene: A golden omelette with cheese on a plate on a breakfast table.

senses.en: the sport of riding waves on a surfboard

ex.en: Surfboarding is popular at the seaside.
ex.zh: 海边很流行冲浪。

ex.en: She practises surfboarding every summer.
ex.zh: 她每年夏天练习冲浪。

tip: surfboarding 与 surfing 都指冲浪运动。
scene: A surfer riding a big wave on a surfboard at the beach.

senses.en: A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

ex.en: Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
ex.zh: 请对着麦克风讲话，让大家都能听见。

ex.en: Using a microphone during lectures can help students hear clearly, particularly in large classrooms with poor acoustics.
ex.zh: 讲课时使用麦克风可以帮助学生听清内容，尤其是在声学条件较差的大教室里。

col: speak into a microphone｜对着麦克风讲话
tip: microphone收音；speaker播放声音，勿混淆。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: on one occasion only
at a time in the past
as soon as something happens or becomes true

ex.en: I water this little cactus once every two weeks.
ex.zh: 我每两周给这株小仙人掌浇一次水。

ex.en: Once reliable public transport becomes available, more commuters may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 一旦有了可靠的公共交通，更多通勤者可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: once引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
ex.zh: 我们轮流选游戏，以保证公平。

ex.en: A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.
ex.zh: 公平的教育制度应让每个孩子都能获得优质教学，不受家庭收入影响。

tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

senses.en: a clothing item covering the foot and lower leg

ex.en: One blue sock was hiding under the bed.
ex.zh: 一只蓝袜子藏在床底下。

ex.en: Choosing durable socks made from recycled materials can help consumers reduce clothing waste over time.
ex.zh: 选择用再生材料制作的耐穿袜子，有助于消费者逐渐减少衣物浪费。

col: a pair of socks｜一双袜子
tip: 一双袜子说a pair of socks，sock为可数名词。

senses.en: a written message sent to a person or organisation
a written symbol representing a sound in an alphabet

ex.en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。

ex.en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
ex.zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。

tip: letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
ex.zh: 这汤太难喝了，我便不再喝了。

ex.en: Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会使人减少户外锻炼，并增加儿童和老年人的健康风险。

col: bad for your health｜有害健康
tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；badly是副词。

senses.en: to return to a place, or to get something again

ex.en: What time did you get back from school?
ex.zh: 你几点从学校回来的？

ex.en: I got my money back from the shop.
ex.zh: 我从商店拿回了钱。

tip: get back 可指“返回”或“收回”；get back home 回家。
scene: A girl walking back home through the front door carrying a school bag.

senses.en: The activity or skill of producing words on a surface.
The way someone's handwritten words look.
Written work, especially books, articles or literary material.

ex.en: I do most of my writing before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我的写作大多在早餐前完成。

ex.en: Regular writing practice helps students organise complex ideas and communicate their arguments more clearly.
ex.zh: 经常练习写作有助于学生组织复杂的想法，并更清楚地表达论点。

tip: writing通常不可数；也是write的现在分词，需去e。

senses.en: On or towards a higher floor of a building.
Located on a higher floor of a building.

ex.en: I left my glasses upstairs beside the bed.
ex.zh: 我把眼镜落在楼上的床边了。

ex.en: Moving bedrooms upstairs can provide greater privacy in homes where the ground floor is used for work.
ex.zh: 在底层用于办公的住宅中，把卧室搬到楼上可以提供更多私密空间。

tip: 作副词时前面不加to：go upstairs。

senses.en: a game where players hit a small ball over a net on a table

ex.en: We play table tennis in the school hall.
ex.zh: 我们在学校大厅里打乒乓球。

ex.en: Table tennis is a fast and exciting game.
ex.zh: 乒乓球是一项快速刺激的运动。

tip: table tennis 即乒乓球，也叫 ping-pong。
scene: Two players playing table tennis with paddles and a small white ball.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the morning

ex.en: Good morning, class!
ex.zh: 同学们，早上好！

ex.en: She wished us good morning as we came in.
ex.zh: 我们进来时她向我们问早安。

tip: good morning 用于早晨的问候（到中午前）。
scene: A teacher greeting students with a smile at the classroom door in the morning.

senses.en: The part of your face used for smelling and breathing.
The front part of an aircraft or similar vehicle.

ex.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
ex.zh: 我的鼻子在冷风中冻红了。

ex.en: Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.
ex.zh: 戴口罩遮住口鼻可以减少吸入空气中的灰尘。

col: the nose of an aircraft｜飞机机头
tip: 擤鼻涕用blow your nose，不用clean。

senses.en: a breakfast food made from grains, often eaten with milk
a plant grown for grain, or the grain it produces

ex.en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
ex.zh: 她把冷牛奶倒进盛着早餐麦片的碗里。

ex.en: Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.
ex.zh: 随着降雨模式变化影响农业生产，农民可能需要种植不同的谷类作物。

col: a bowl of cereal｜一碗麦片
tip: 早餐食品泛指时常不可数；指谷物种类可用cereals。

senses.en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.

ex.en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只绿色的小昆虫落在了我的袖子上。

ex.en: Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 许多昆虫物种为农作物授粉，因此保护它们对粮食生产和健康的生态系统至关重要。

tip: 可数名词；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。

senses.en: a card mailed without an envelope, often showing a picture

ex.en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
ex.zh: 她从一个海边村庄给我寄来了一张明信片。

ex.en: Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.
ex.zh: 虽然电子信息传递得更快，但寄明信片能让旅行者与家人之间的联系更具人情味。

tip: 寄给某人可说send someone a postcard或用to引出收件人。

senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你丢了钥匙，请联系接待员。

ex.en: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 经常与家人联系可以减轻独居老年人的孤独感。

col: keep in contact with｜与……保持联系
tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。

senses.en: A person responsible for running a business, team, or department.

ex.en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
ex.zh: 经理帮一位新员工整理了货架。

ex.en: An effective manager encourages open communication and ensures that employees have sufficient resources to complete their tasks.
ex.zh: 高效的管理者鼓励开放沟通，并确保员工有充足的资源完成任务。

tip: manager指管理者；management可指管理工作或管理层。

senses.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
the person in charge of a group or organisation
to move or travel in a particular direction

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

senses.en: On the day before today.
The day immediately before today.

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天把雨伞落在公交车上了。

ex.en: The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.
ex.zh: 昨天发布的交通调查表明，在市中心通勤的人越来越倾向于骑车而非开车。

tip: yesterday前通常不用介词，常与一般过去时连用。

senses.en: A woman who serves food and drinks in a restaurant.

ex.en: The waitress brought us warm bread and fresh soup.
ex.zh: 女服务员给我们端来了温热的面包和新鲜的汤。

ex.en: Working as a waitress can help students develop communication skills while earning money to support their studies.
ex.zh: 当餐厅服务员能帮助学生培养沟通能力，同时赚钱支付学习费用。

col: work as a waitress｜当女服务员
a friendly waitress｜友善的女服务员
ask the waitress｜询问女服务员
tip: waitress特指女性；server可不区分性别。

senses.en: A thing that is not named or specified.

ex.en: There is something soft inside this little box.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里有个柔软的东西。

ex.en: Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.
ex.zh: 每天学习一点新东西，有助于成年人保持好奇心并适应职场变化。

tip: 修饰词放后面，如something useful；作主语用单数。

senses.en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.
To gently touch an animal with your hand.

ex.en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们的宠物兔喜欢躲在厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: Caring for a pet can help children develop responsibility and learn to recognise the needs of others.
ex.zh: 照顾宠物能帮助儿童培养责任感，并学会察觉他人的需求。

tip: 动词过去式为petted；英式英语中抚摸也常用stroke。

senses.en: without anyone else present
without other people or their help
only, excluding everything or everyone else

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
ex.zh: 水壶里的水烧开时，厨房里只有我一个人。

ex.en: Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.
ex.zh: 政府无法独力解决环境问题，因为持久的进步也需要企业和公民个人的合作。

tip: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

ex.en: Dad was mad because I broke his favourite cup.
ex.zh: 爸爸很生气，因为我打碎了他最喜欢的杯子。

ex.en: Although some residents are mad about football, public sports funding should support a wider range of activities.
ex.zh: 虽然一些居民热衷足球，但公共体育资金应支持更广泛的活动。

tip: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
ex.zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: To end an activity or prevent something from happening.
A place where buses or other vehicles regularly collect passengers.
An interruption of movement or a brief stay somewhere.

ex.en: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
ex.zh: 雨越下越大，我们便停下了脚步。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.
ex.zh: 随着人口增长，城市应改善公共交通，防止交通拥堵进一步恶化。

col: stop someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
tip: stop doing是停止做；stop to do是停下去做。

senses.en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel.
An officially recognised day when many people do not work.
To spend time away from home for pleasure.

ex.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

ex.en: Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.
ex.zh: 灵活的休假安排可以改善员工福祉，同时让企业全年维持基本服务。

tip: 英式on holiday指度假；美式通常说on vacation。

senses.en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.
Located at or near the forward part of something.
A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。

ex.en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

col: at the front of｜在……的前部
tip: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

senses.en: to talk about something and exchange ideas
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一些坚果，留着当零食吃。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供营养丰富的点心来代替高糖食品，从而鼓励更健康的饮食习惯。

col: snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

ex.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
ex.zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。

ex.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
ex.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。

tip: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧闹声只用racket。

senses.en: The dark part of each day when the sun is down.

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

ex.en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
ex.zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。

col: ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事
ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

senses.en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms.
An outer cover that protects a book or object.

ex.en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
ex.zh: 我抓起外套，才走进寒冷的室外。

ex.en: A durable jacket made from recycled materials can offer consumers a more sustainable clothing choice.
ex.zh: 用再生材料制成的耐穿夹克可以为消费者提供更可持续的服装选择。

tip: jacket通常是短外套，不专指羽绒服。

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.
Believed to bring good fortune.

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
ex.zh: 我们很幸运，赶上了回家的末班公交车。

ex.en: Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.
ex.zh: 虽然一些创业者受益于偶然的机遇，但企业的长期成功通常需要周密规划和持续努力。

col: a lucky break｜好运带来的机会
tip: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。

senses.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

ex.en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
ex.zh: 这条牛仔裤洗后还没干。

ex.en: Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.
ex.zh: 允许员工穿牛仔裤可能营造更轻松的工作环境，而不一定降低职业标准。

col: a pair of jeans｜一条牛仔裤
tip: jeans用复数；一条用a pair of jeans。

senses.en: a friend you write letters to but may never meet

ex.en: I have a penfriend in Australia.
ex.zh: 我有一个澳大利亚的笔友。

ex.en: She wrote a letter to her penfriend in English.
ex.zh: 她用英语给笔友写了一封信。

tip: penfriend 是英式说法，pen pal 是美式说法。
scene: A girl writing a letter at a desk with a world map behind her.

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
ex.zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。

ex.en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service
to send a letter or parcel through a postal service

ex.en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。

ex.en: Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信已很普及，许多农村居民仍依赖邮政收取重要文件。

col: send by mail｜通过邮政寄送
tip: mail作“邮件”通常不可数；英式日常也常用post。

senses.en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage.
To make someone leave their job.
To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.

ex.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在炉火旁暖手。

ex.en: Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.
ex.zh: 定期安全检查可以降低电气系统老化的旧住宅楼发生火灾的风险。

tip: catch fire指开始着火；be on fire指正在燃烧。

senses.en: a female sibling
a woman who belongs to a religious community

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
ex.zh: 我妹妹总是借穿我最喜欢的蓝色毛衣。

ex.en: Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.
ex.zh: 经常与兄弟姐妹分担责任的孩子，可能会在家中培养出更强的合作能力。

tip: sister不分姐姐妹妹；需用older或younger说明年龄关系。

senses.en: thin clothes covering the legs worn by women or children

ex.en: She wore red tights with her dress.
ex.zh: 她穿着红色连裤袜配连衣裙。

ex.en: A pair of tights is in the laundry basket.
ex.zh: 洗衣篮里有一条连裤袜。

col: a pair of tights｜一条连裤袜
tip: tights 常用复数；一条说 a pair of tights。
scene: A pair of red tights hanging over a chair in a bedroom.

senses.en: To design or make something that did not exist before.
To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.

ex.en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
ex.zh: 我姐姐发明了一种巧妙的摘苹果工具。

ex.en: Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 工程师必须发明价格可负担的技术，帮助农村社区获得清洁饮用水。

tip: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
ex.zh: 我们在悬崖后面发现了一片安静的海滩。

ex.en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
ex.zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: also; in addition

ex.en: She speaks French, and she speaks German as well.
ex.zh: 她会说法语，也会说德语。

ex.en: I'll have a coffee, and a cake as well, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡，再来一块蛋糕。

tip: as well 放在句末，too 常放句末，also 常放句中。
scene: A café table with a cup of coffee and a slice of chocolate cake.

senses.en: to move or travel somewhere

ex.en: We go to school by bike.
ex.zh: 我们骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们去公园吧。

tip: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone/been。
scene: Two children riding bikes along a road towards a school.

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

ex.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.
ex.zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

ex.en: The motorbike stopped in front of the café.
ex.zh: 摩托车停在咖啡馆前面。

tip: motorbike 是英式口语说法；motorcycle 更正式。
scene: A red motorbike parked on a street with a helmet on the seat.

senses.en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring.
To spend the winter in a particular place.

ex.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
ex.zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。

ex.en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
ex.zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

tip: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

senses.en: a trained professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses
a person who has earned the highest university degree
to change something dishonestly to deceive people

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。

col: a doctor of philosophy｜哲学博士
tip: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck, usually white

ex.en: A white swan glided silently across the lake.
ex.zh: 一只白天鹅悄无声息地游过湖面。

ex.en: Protecting wetland habitats benefits swan populations while also preserving the wider ecosystems on which many other species depend.
ex.zh: 保护湿地栖息地有益于天鹅种群，同时也能保护许多其他物种赖以生存的更广泛生态系统。

col: a pair of swans｜一对天鹅
tip: 可数名词，复数swans；幼天鹅称cygnet。

senses.en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.

ex.en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
ex.zh: 电影结束后，我们分着吃了一张蘑菇比萨。

ex.en: Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.
ex.zh: 虽然比萨方便食用，但其营养价值主要取决于食材和食用份量。

col: a slice of pizza｜一片比萨
tip: 整张可数：a pizza；泛指食物可说some pizza。

senses.en: cooked in very hot water

ex.en: I like boiled eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐我喜欢吃煮鸡蛋。

ex.en: She made boiled potatoes for dinner.
ex.zh: 她晚饭做了煮土豆。

tip: boiled 指用开水煮过的；fried 是煎的，roasted 是烤的。
scene: Two boiled eggs in an egg cup on a breakfast table with toast.

senses.en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area

ex.en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。

ex.en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。

col: packed stadium｜座无虚席的体育场
tip: 复数可用stadiums或stadia，前者更常见。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
ex.zh: 每个学生都带了一片树叶来上科学课。

ex.en: Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.
ex.zh: 小班教学可能让教师为每个学生提供更多个别指导和有用的反馈。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: Unable to find the way, or unable to be found.
Unable to understand something or decide what to do.
Past tense and past participle of lose.

ex.en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
ex.zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。

ex.en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
ex.zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。

tip: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

senses.en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts.
Two people who are together or work together.
To put people or things together in groups of two.

ex.en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
ex.zh: 我把最喜欢的那双手套落在公交车上了。

ex.en: Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.
ex.zh: 教师常将各有所长的学生配成一组，以鼓励合作并改善学习成效。

col: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀
work in pairs｜两人一组工作
pair up with someone｜与某人结成一组
tip: a pair of shoes作主语时，谓语用单数。

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
ex.zh: 一名学生把背包落在了图书馆的书桌下面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.
ex.zh: 大学应确保每位学生在整个求学期间都能获得负担得起的住宿及适当支持。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

senses.en: Used when you are both the subject and object.
Used to emphasize the person being addressed.

ex.en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
ex.zh: 用那把刀时要小心，别割伤自己。

ex.en: Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.
ex.zh: 亲自做饭可以减少家庭开支，同时让你更好地把控营养质量。

tip: 对应单数you；对多人说“你们自己”用yourselves。

senses.en: The amount of money needed to buy something.
Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else.
To decide how much money something will cost.

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
ex.zh: 这周新鲜草莓的价格降了。

ex.en: Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨给低收入家庭带来很大压力，在城市地区尤其如此。

tip: 价格高低用high或low；物品贵便宜用expensive或cheap。

senses.en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard
an area for playing sports such as tennis or basketball
to seek something desirable or risk something harmful

ex.en: She will appear in court on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 她将于星期一上午出庭。

ex.en: Local councils should provide public tennis courts so that more residents can exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 地方议会应提供公共网球场，让更多居民能够经常锻炼。

tip: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。

senses.en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present.
To continue for a period or remain usable.
After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
ex.zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。

ex.en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

tip: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

senses.en: Used to express that something is definitely true.
Used to agree politely to a request.

ex.en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
ex.zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。

ex.en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。

col: will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

senses.en: Having very little money or few possessions
Of low quality or lacking something necessary
Deserving sympathy because of an unfortunate situation

ex.en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。

tip: poor at表示不擅长；poor in表示缺乏。

senses.en: used to say something is necessary

ex.en: I have to get up early tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天必须早起。

ex.en: Do we have to wear a uniform at school?
ex.zh: 我们在学校必须穿校服吗？

tip: have to 表客观需要，must 表主观必须；否定 don't have to 是“不必”。
scene: A student in a school uniform looking at an alarm clock.

senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.
Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

ex.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
ex.zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。

ex.en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

col: go to the gym｜去健身房
tip: gym是gymnasium的简称；去健身房用go to the gym。

senses.en: the presence of different things rather than only one kind
a particular type of something

ex.en: We add variety to lunch with different colourful vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们用各种色彩鲜艳的蔬菜让午餐更丰富。

ex.en: Schools should offer a wide variety of activities to support students with different interests.
ex.zh: 学校应提供丰富多样的活动，以支持兴趣各异的学生。

col: a wide variety of｜各种各样的
a variety of reasons｜多种原因
tip: 多样性为不可数义；表示一种品种时可数。
